description: This Java class defines the 'ShutdownResponse', a final class extending 'CommonCommandResponse', representing the response to a shutdown command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, setting headers, and standard overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString, along with handling JSON payloads.
